name: 30523 · Clarkesville, GA
findings: ZIP 30523 (Clarkesville) has 46 nonprofit organizations. 13 of them (28%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 12 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (44% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 30523 (Clarkesville) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
31% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 30523 (Clarkesville) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 29% of the typical level).
